title: SessionContext allows current_group/current_article_number to be inconsistent with GroupSelected state
description:
In crates/reader/src/session/context.rs, the session has three separate fields that must stay in sync: state (Authenticating/Active/GroupSelected), current_group: Option<GroupName>, and current_article_number: Option<u64>. The invariant is: GroupSelected implies current_group.is_some(). But this is not encoded in the type. Code in lifecycle.rs checks ctx.state.group_selected() AND ctx.current_group.as_ref() independently, with separate 412 fallbacks. The second check should be unreachable if the first is correct, but the compiler cannot see that.

Suggested improvement: when transitioning to GroupSelected, make current_group a required parameter and set it in the same operation. Consider a small struct:

  struct SelectedGroup {
      name: GroupName,
      current_article_number: Option<u64>,
  }

and SessionContext.selected_group: Option<SelectedGroup>, replacing both current_group and current_article_number. Then ctx.selected_group.as_ref() returns the group and article number together, and their joint presence/absence is enforced by construction.
